root_cause: Python CodeQL used github.run_id for push-event concurrency so newer same-ref pushes could not supersede stale work; terminal guidance also allowed an active exact-SHA security run to leak into user-facing handoff.
prevention: Use stable PR/ref CodeQL concurrency, never github.run_id.
Newest exact-SHA security run is authoritative.
Never hand active post-merge security work back to the user.
Treat a client response transport interruption as non-terminal and resume the canonical delivery lineage on the next executable turn.
evidence: PR #3101 was closed and its branch reset before merge; recovery reconstructs only the missing delta from current main.
Required merge-candidate testing also exposed the missing isHardAssetFailure import on current main, fixed without reverting newer main behavior.
Client response transport can end while repository delivery remains active; recovery must resume canonical repository state rather than report completion.
